title: BAPAL Semantic Model Interchange v1
description: Stable structural interchange for one finite semantic model. World identity is its preserved array index. Runtime semantic validation additionally requires every target to be within the worlds array, to identify a live non-null world, and every identifier to be a nonempty well-formed Unicode scalar string.

worlds.description: Stable world slots. Array order and null positions are semantically significant and must not be compacted.

identifier.description: An exact, non-normalized identifier. Runtime validation rejects isolated UTF-16 surrogate code units so that the value is a well-formed Unicode scalar string.

target.description: A safe non-negative array index. Runtime validation requires target < worlds.length and worlds[target] to be non-null.

trueAtoms.description: The exact set of atoms true at this world. Canonical encoders sort these identifiers by Unicode scalar value without normalization.

transitions.description: The exact set of outgoing target/agent pairs. Canonical encoders sort by numeric target and then by the agent's Unicode scalar values.
